SPECIMEN                  :   Right lung biopsy for IHC markers.

GROSS                        :   Received 1 formalin fixed paraffin embedded block labelled as S/24, 2280

IHC MARKER H Score Result
ROS-1 0 Negative


Comment: All external controls show appropriate reactivity.
Interpretation:        

  • 0 for absent expression, 1+ for weak staining, 2+ for moderate staining, and 3+ for strong staining
  • H-score was calculated as follows: H-score = (0 × percentage of cells with absent cytoplasmic staining) + (1 × percentage of 1+ cells) + (2 × percentage of 2+ cells) + (3 × percentage of 3+ cells).
  • Score of =/>100 viewed as positive
  • Cases resulted as Positive (H-score ≥100) must be confirmed by FISH testing on the same block.

References:

  1. ROS1 Immunohistochemistry Among Major Genotypes of Non-Small-Cell Lung Cancer. Theresa A. Boyle, Katsuhiro Masago, Kim E. Ellison, Yasushi Yatabe and Fred R. Hirsch. Clin Lung Cancer. 2015 March ; 16(2): 106-111. doi:10.1016/j.cllc.2014.10.003
  2. A Validation Study for the Use of ROS1 Immunohistochemical Staining in Screening for ROS1 Translocations in Lung Cancer. Patrizia Viola, Manisha Maurya, James Croud, Jana Gazdova, Nadia Suleman, Eric Lim, et al. Journal of Thoracic Oncology Vol. 11 No. 7: 1029-1039
ADVISED :   Clinical & radiological correlation.

COMMENT
ROS1 (Clone D4D6) : ROS1 is a receptor tyrosine kinase with structural similarity to Anaplastic Lymphoma Kinase (ALK) protein. In patients with Non Small Cell Lung cancer (NSCLC), ROS1 expression is found in approximately 2% of these patients who tend to be younger with a median age of 49 years, no history of smoking & with a diagnosis of Adenocarcinoma. Detection of ROS1 in lung cancer is important for optimal treatment as it can be efficiently inhibited by tyrosine kinase inhibitor Crizotinib.
